unified_table: outputs/headline/forecast_unified_all_categories.csv (9 моделей вкл. ансамбль, 4 горизонта, разброс MAE по МО)
statement: Checks on delivered files, not independent validation of model generalization. 'models'=7 refers to predictions.csv; the unified forecast table adds CatBoost and a pre-specified 0.5/0.5 CatBoost+LightGBM ensemble (9 models). Audit v16: selection and evaluation are fully separated. The committed strategy is chosen ONLY on early cutoffs (selected_on_early); the late slice merely MEASURES that unchanged choice (late_evaluation); the descriptive table minimum is a separate field (benchmark_best_by_horizon). The late slice does NOT participate in selection. A retrospective split of already-seen data is NOT an untouched final test.
selection_vs_evaluation: selected_on_early (early-only, pure function select_strategy_on_early) vs late_evaluation (measurement only, not revised) vs benchmark_best_by_horizon (descriptive). On h=1 the early pick (Prophet) lost on the late slice (863.2 vs ensemble 297.0) and the choice was NOT revised; on h=3 the early pick (ensemble) held; h=6/h=12 are not_evaluated_late (no mature late labels).
